name: Son of a Rich
source:
You play as an affluent heir living an impeccable life. Things, however, take a grim turn when we get to hear the demise of our father. But it isn't just a natural death; it's an enigma waiting for its interpretation. So, set forth a journey that is full of lust, greed and depravity.​

[From [url=https://f95zone.to/threads/son-of-a-rich-v0-2-1-dikydik.51718/]F95 Zone[/url]]
translation:
你扮演一个富裕的继承人，过着无可挑剔的生活。然而，当我们听到父亲去世的消息时，事情发生了严峻的转变。但这不仅仅是自然死亡，而是自然死亡。这是一个等待它解释的谜。于是，踏上一段充满情欲、贪婪和堕落的旅程。​

[来自[url=https://f95zone.to/threads/son-of-a-rich-v0-2-1-dikydik.51718/]F95区[/url]]
